title: SketchAssist AI custom attribute sample (one CSV row)
description: Controlled vocabulary version 1.1. Generated by scripts/generate_dataset_schema.py - do not edit by hand.

group_id.description: Rows describing the SAME face in different languages share a group_id and must carry identical labels.

split.description: dev = used while building the parser; test = held back.

description_text.description: The witness-style description, in the script of its language.

apparent_gender.description: Apparent gender. Empty = the text does not say (or is contradictory).

age_description.description: Apparent age. Empty = the text does not say (or is contradictory).

skin_colour.description: Skin colour. Empty = the text does not say (or is contradictory).

face_shape.description: Face shape. Empty = the text does not say (or is contradictory).

hair_length.description: Hair length. Empty = the text does not say (or is contradictory).

hair_style.description: Hair style. Empty = the text does not say (or is contradictory).

eyebrows.description: Eyebrow thickness. Empty = the text does not say (or is contradictory).

eye_shape.description: Eye shape. Empty = the text does not say (or is contradictory).

nose_shape.description: Nose shape. Empty = the text does not say (or is contradictory).

mouth_shape.description: Mouth shape. Empty = the text does not say (or is contradictory).

facial_hair.description: Facial hair. Empty = the text does not say (or is contradictory).

glasses.description: Glasses. Empty = the text does not say (or is contradictory).

translation_review_status.description: original = English source text; unreviewed / in_review / reviewed = status of a translation.

permission_status.description: synthetic_no_real_person = invented text, no real individual involved.

image_file.description: Optional relative path of an image inside the dataset folder.
